title: ExtremeWeather CI Physics Centroiding Localization Verification
description: Comparative evaluation of satellite microphysical centroiding (cold-top overshooting + cloud-top cooling rate field) versus crude window geometric center.

evaluation_protocol.physics_centroid_formula: 0.5 * (y_cold, x_cold) + 0.5 * (y_cool, x_cool) where cold is BT13(T-10) minimum pixel and cool is weighted centroid of top 10% cooling pixels Delta BT13 = BT13(T-40) - BT13(T-10).
